# Decisions due

*Generated by `python tools/register.py render` from `decisions-due.yaml`; edit the YAML, never this page. Each item points to its row in the [future-work register](future-work.md), which holds the detail.*

What the operator and the designer still owe the [future-work register](future-work.md), and which work waits for
it, soonest first. "Due by" is the gate or milestone the decision must come before. It is not a date: the current
phase is in [`docs/README.md`](../README.md). Needs is one of three things: a **decision** (a question to answer), a
**design** (a document to write) or an **adoption** (a written design or ADR to accept or amend).

`python tools/register.py check` (and CI) keeps the list current. An item whose row closes, or a blocked row that
closes, fails the check until it is removed or updated. Every open question (§4) and every row targeted
**Designer** must have an item here.
